LanguageData.GuildQuest_Daily_SiteClearance.label: Site Clearance
LanguageData.GuildQuest_Daily_SiteClearance.letterTex:
The envoy explains the details of the extermination commission.

The Guild has found an evil faction outpost nearby,
and leaving it alone would badly endanger the surrounding area. They ask that adventurers be sent to wipe it out.

Do you accept?
LanguageData.GuildQuest_RankUp_SiteClearance.label: Site Clearance
LanguageData.GuildQuest_RankUp_SiteClearance.letterTe:
The envoy explains the details of the Rank-Up Quest and reminds you to prepare.

The Guild has found an evil faction outpost nearby,
and leaving it alone would badly endanger the surrounding area. They ask that adventurers be sent to wipe it out.
LanguageData.GuildQuest_AncientRelic.label: Ancient Relic
LanguageData.GuildQuest_AncientRelic.letterText:
The envoy brings word of a newly discovered ruin.

It is said that the ruin recently found near the colony holds an important treasure left behind by the spirits of old.

Travel to the ruin, retrieve the relic box, and bring it back to your settlement. A Guild shuttle will arrive in a few days; hand the box over to the shuttle to complete the commission.
Once the treasure is taken, the Dark Faction that covets its power may come to claim it. Stay alert.

Do you accept?
LanguageData.GuildQuest_Daily_CriminalHunt.label: Criminal Hunt
LanguageData.GuildQuest_Daily_CriminalHunt.letterText:
The envoy brings a wanted notice issued by the Guild.

A wanted criminal is hiding in a criminal outpost near the colony,
guarded by armed bandits. The Guild asks you to send adventurers to bring them to justice.

Kill the criminal on the spot, or take them prisoner and bring them back to the colony to hand over to the Guild's extradition shuttle.
If you deliver the prisoner alive, the reward is doubled.

Do you accept?
LanguageData.GuildQuest_RankUp_RefugeeResettle.label: Refugee Resettlement
LanguageData.GuildQuest_RankUp_RefugeeResettle.letter:
The envoy explains the details of the Rank-Up Quest and reminds you to prepare.

A group of refugees hunted by the Dark Faction hopes to be sheltered at your colony for a time.
They will stay at the colony for 15 days, after which a Guild shuttle will take them to be resettled elsewhere.
Protect them from the Dark Faction's pursuit, and see as many of them off alive as you can.
LanguageData.GuildQuest_Rescue.label: Rescue
LanguageData.GuildQuest_Rescue.letterText:
The envoy brings a distress signal.

A trade caravan was attacked by monsters near the colony, its members are unaccounted for, and help is urgently needed.

Travel to the marked location, clear the threat, and rescue the wounded. After a time, their faction will send a shuttle to pick them up.
Protect them while you wait, and see as many of them off alive as you can.

Do you accept?
LanguageData.GuildQuest_RankUp_SupplyEscort.label: Supply Escort
LanguageData.GuildQuest_RankUp_SupplyEscort.letterTex:
The envoy explains the details of the Rank-Up Quest and reminds you to prepare.

The Guild has a shipment of supplies that must be moved urgently.
Reach the pickup point and take charge of the supplies within 12 days, then complete the delivery to finish the quest.
Members of the Dark Faction may try to seize the supplies along the way. Be prepared.
